shared_elements: frontal or profile human/anthropomorphic figure occupying the whole field
carved relief with incised linear detail on body/garment
arms brought toward the centre of the body
justification: Both surfaces depict a single upright anthropomorphic figure filling the field, with a distinct headdress above and incised detail across the torso, and both centre the arms on the body. But A is a naturalistic profile figure with beard, pleated robe and a long staff gripped in the hand, while B is a blocky frontal schematic figure with abstract circular/oval motifs and no identifiable attribute held, so the shared traits are generic to figural art rather than a shared scheme.
